Infrastructure cost review, October

One of the four database servers were running at under 12% utilization for the whole month. We propose consolidating it with db-03 in December, which should save about $2,100 per month.

Some advance planning is required, since the consolidation needs a maintenance window of at least four hours. We suggest the weekend of December 12.

labels.notes: "One of the servers" takes a singular verb.
